node_9.description: This is Giorgio Rossi's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 8:00 am, engage in research on mathematical patterns in nature from 8:30 am to 11:30 am, take a break and enjoy a light lunch at 11:30 am, continue studying new mathematical theories from 12:00 pm to 2:00 pm, attend an online mathematics class from 2:30 pm to 4:00 pm, have dinner at 4:00 pm, discuss the upcoming local mayor election with friends from 5:00 pm to 6:00 pm, browse news articles about the election and potential candidates from 6:30 pm to 8:00 pm.
